name: loop-detect
description: Detects stuck tool-call loops (identical repeats, ping-pong) and escalates: nudge, stronger nudge, stop the run

enabled.description: Watch tool calls for loop patterns. Silent unless a loop is detected.

repeatThreshold.description: Consecutive identical tool calls (same name + canonicalized arguments) before the first nudge. A stronger nudge follows at 2x, the run stops at 3x.

pingPongThreshold.description: Strictly alternating calls (A,B,A,B,...) before the first nudge. Stronger nudge at 2x, stop at 3x.
